propositions: The project portability criterion's Platform and venue matrix cell currently lists 'CI' as a single undifferentiated cell, making projects with no CI provider or non-GitHub CI providers unnameable alternate shapes for portability findings.

A capability or plan whose only trigger is a specific CI system (e.g. GitHub Actions schedule) without an operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and should fire a portability finding when evaluated against a no-CI-provider shape.
The rubric text in .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md must be the authoritative single source; docs/plan-review-gate.md and test assertions must mirror it exactly to prevent drift.
Live detection must distinguish between pre-change (no finding on CI-only triggers) and post-change (finding on CI-only triggers) rubrics to prove the rule is actually enforced, not just stated.
